about: Pose prompts for a rank-and-file sword soldier (man), a soldier of the player's army (the game recolours soldiers for the enemy). Every pose takes the standing image (art/source/soldier-sword-m-stand.jpg) as its one reference.
base: The exact same character as the reference: the same face, short brown hair, a steel kettle helmet, a chainmail coif, steel pauldrons, a blue tabard with white trim over chainmail, steel greaves, a brown belt with pouches, a small round blue shield with a steel rim (round, not a kite shield) on the left arm, a plain straight sword, same colours, same art style, same size in frame. Three-quarter side view facing right. Pose: {pose}. He holds exactly one sword: no second sword, no afterimage, no ghost or blurred copies. A single sharp still frame: no motion blur, no speed lines, no smear, no sparks or effects. Whole figure in frame with margin around it, sword included, even studio lighting, no cast shadow. Plain flat pure green background (#00FF00), no green on the character, no text, no ground.

ready.pose: sinking into a low stance behind the same small round blue shield, knees bent, the sword held low and back at his right side with the blade pointing forward, eyes fixed ahead; drawn smaller in the frame so that everything fits, from the top of the raised sword down to his boots, with empty space below his feet

wind-up.pose: the sword drawn far back and raised behind his right shoulder for a sweeping slash, his body twisted back, the shield held forward, weight on his back foot

slash.pose: mid-slash: lunging forward, his right arm swept forward and fully extended at shoulder height, the sword held out ahead with its blade pointing forward and away from his body, toward the target, the shield pulled in

follow-through.pose: the slash finished: his right arm swept down in front, the sword's blade pointing forward and down ahead, its tip low near the ground in front of his front foot, leaning forward over his front knee

recover.pose: drawing back out of the slash and straightening up, weight shifting back, the shield raised and the sword returning to a guard

victory.pose: standing tall, the sword raised high above his head, the shield lowered at his side, cheering; drawn smaller in the frame so that everything fits, from the top of the raised sword down to his boots, with empty space below his feet

run.pose: running to the right mid-stride, one foot off the ground, the sword held low at his right side pointing forward, the shield on his left arm, tabard flapping

run-2.pose: running to the right in the passing position: one leg swinging past the other, both feet close to the ground, the sword held low at his right side pointing forward, the shield on his left arm, tabard flapping

hurt.pose: recoiling backward from a hit, head turned away, teeth gritted in pain, one arm raised, the sword lowered in the other hand, staggering

fallen.pose: fallen to one knee, slumped forward with his head down, defeated, the sword lying on the ground beside him
